title: Restoration shaman, level 8-9
subtitle: New at 8: 2 Lightning Shield, 3 Earth Shock, 4 Lightning Bolt
summary: Restoration shaman keys as of level 8. New: 2 Lightning Shield, 3 Earth Shock, 4 Lightning Bolt.
notes: Apply the step that matches your level. Spells you haven't learned yet are skipped.
Each step builds on the one before, so applying the next step over this one is safe.
Talent spells are not included. Put those on an empty key yourself.
